exact_Cartan_norms_and_FD.FD_flat_constructive_proof: Set messenger Fbar,F=0 and singlets S_A=S_B=0; impose Tr27 A²=vA², Tr27 B²=vB². Then all holomorphic F-terms vanish. Hermitian commuting A and B lie in a common compact Cartan so adjoint D^a proportional to [A†,A]+[B†,B] vanishes.
exact_Cartan_norms_and_FD.critical_missing: These are moduli of F/D flat backgrounds, not a uniquely selected vacuum. Soft one-loop potential, full E6 gauge/Higgs quantum corrections and other adjoint invariants control their stability.

physical_caveat: Even the B-only 1-loop grid minimum is not a global vacuum: full potential includes SUSY-breaking counterterms, E6 gauge/higgs modes and all Cartan directions. Scan is 720 angles under fixed B norm, excluding messenger fermion masses below 0.15M. The benchmark can be metastable or unselected.
